candidates.summary: Run's seedSet is dead: every seed is queued before the loop, so `seedSet[link] ||` admits nothing the crawl would miss (Run 46 -> 41 lines)
candidates.failure_scenario: Run() builds seedSet from c.Seeds() (:112-115) and ORs it into the link filter (:148) so that a link back to a seeded directory page — /r/x, which inScope rejects at :191/:201 — is still followed. Those seeds are already in `queue` before the loop starts, and every dequeued URL is marked visited at :125, so a link equal to a seed is always either visited or still queued: the extra term can only ever append a duplicate. The map, its four-line build and the second filter term encode a rule the queue already enforces, and the next person touching the link filter has to re-derive that the two are the same rule.

candidates.summary: Crawler.order is a parallel key list for c.pages with one consumer; deleting it removes the field, the append and the reset Run() forgets (3 lines out, 2 in)
candidates.failure_scenario: order exists only to give writePages (:327) the crawl order, which nothing observes — each page writes its own file, and the sorted key order produces a byte-identical tree. Meanwhile Run() resets c.pages (:110) and neither c.order nor c.fileBudget, so a second Run on the same Crawler walks stale URLs in writePages and nil-derefs, and starts with the previous run's per-file budget already spent. Adding `c.order = nil` to Run repairs one field and keeps the shape that caused it: the parallel structure has to be reset in lockstep forever, and c.fileBudget already shows the miss repeating. Deleting the field removes the whole class.

candidates.summary: the `n == 0` asset warning counts /public/ over the whole asset tree while the invariant it names is one prefix in one file
candidates.failure_scenario: copyTree returns the count of `/public/` across every .js and .css it copied (:573) and Write warns only when that total is zero, saying 'check js/index.js still needs relativizing' (:314-316). Today the total is exactly one occurrence, in js/index.js, so the guard tracks the invariant by coincidence. Let any stylesheet gain a `url(/public/imgs/x.svg)` and the count stays non-zero while index.js's hardcoded '/public/js/controller-' prefix is gone: every dynamic controller import 404s from the preview's mount point, the snapshot silently loses the interactive controls, and the warning the comment promises never fires. The check belongs on the string the comment names, in the file it names.
candidates.verify_by: grep -rc '/public/' gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/public/js/index.js gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/public/main.css (1 and 0, so the whole-tree count is index.js's count); then make the guard count '/public/js/controller-' in js/index.js and re-run cd misc/gnopreview && go test ./...
